Depletion of regulatory T cells (Tregs) in Foxp3-DTR mice leads to loss of M cells from the follicle-associated epithelium (FAE).
Immunofluorescence imaging of Peyer's patch sections. Tregs (Foxp3, yellow) are located close to the crypt regions adjacent to the FAE. Spi-B labeling (magenta) marks developing, immature M cells in the epithelium.
